metadata.coverage_preamble: Today holds the pew, the penny loaf, the shutter, and a cross.

yesterday: The Mayor was three pews off, furred and exact. He answered short and cold.
The loaf was a penny, a full thumb short. You are walking for the back.
The jaw has a pulse. That is why the night has a cross.
Tomorrow is the Knave at two. You play.
